meta.title: Suggestions for review - NOTHING IMPLEMENTED
meta.rule: Every suggestion below is a proposal only. The owner reviews, then marks Accept / Modify / Reject with a date in a private copy. No suggestion authorizes contact with tenant, brokers, or agencies by itself.

suggestions.suggestion: Resolve the exact expiry date first (estoppel + recorded lease) before any pricing discussion.
suggestions.why: The brief's 2030-2035 range spans the model's widest value swing; term remaining is the primary NNN pricing variable. Selling with 9 years vs 4 years remaining are different assets.
suggestions.risk_if_skipped: Mispricing by years of term; negotiating blind.

suggestions.suggestion: Run a dual track: (1) approach tenant for a 10-15 year blend-and-extend at/above in-place rent; (2) in parallel, quietly prepare a 1031 sale package.
suggestions.why: Extension converts a wasting lease into a financeable 10+ year income stream; the sale track creates competitive tension and a fallback if extension pricing is weak. Prior workbooks converge on this sequencing.
suggestions.evidence: M29-M31 (contracting tenant: negotiate from remaining leverage now, not at expiry)
suggestions.risk_if_skipped: At expiry the tenant holds all leverage; a dark box reprices as land + re-tenant cost.

suggestions.suggestion: Do not hold passively to expiry without an extension. Treat 'do nothing' as a decision with the worst tail in the model.
suggestions.why: Monte Carlo floor (P05) and certainty-equivalent rank passive hold last: expiry, dark-store, and re-tenant risks concentrate in one year.
suggestions.evidence: Model strategies C/D; Risks R-01, R-02
suggestions.risk_if_skipped: Forced sale / vacancy at the weakest negotiating point.

suggestions.suggestion: Price the ULA cliff explicitly once a price range exists; consider timing/structure only with tax counsel.
suggestions.why: Crossing $5.4M (City of LA, post Jun 30 2026 thresholds) triggers 4% on the FULL price - a ~$216k+ step at the threshold (M35).

suggestions.suggestion: Get two broker opinions of value (BOVs) on both bases: as-is term, and as-if-extended 10-15 years.
suggestions.why: No official cap rate exists (B07). The gap between the two BOVs IS the dollar value of SG-02 and decides whether extension effort is worth it.
suggestions.risk_if_skipped: Anchoring on normalized model multiples instead of market bids.

suggestions.suggestion: Request tenant store-level sales under lease audit rights; track rent coverage quarterly.
suggestions.why: Coverage is the best observable predictor of renewal/closure; system SSS (-4.2% YTD) cannot tell you about THIS store (Q-05).
suggestions.risk_if_skipped: Discovering closure intent from a press release.

suggestions.suggestion: Bind insurance early: obtain EQ + wildfire/FAIR-Plan-aware quotes for hold and sale disclosures.
suggestions.why: Jan 2025 fires (16,251 structures destroyed, M40-M41) repriced CA commercial insurance; an uninsurable or 3x-premium parcel changes hold math and buyer underwriting.
suggestions.risk_if_skipped: Premium shock absorbed silently by NOI; buyer retrades.

suggestions.suggestion: Pre-build the 1031 replacement pipeline (diversified NNN / DST options with verified rents) BEFORE listing.
suggestions.why: 45-day identification clock starts at closing (M38). A prepared pipeline prevents a forced overpriced replacement - the most common 1031 wealth leak.
suggestions.risk_if_skipped: Tax deferral 'saved' but economics lost on replacement pricing.

suggestions.suggestion: Quantify the Prop 13 hold subsidy (assessed vs market value) and count it as a real cost of exchanging.
suggestions.why: Exchange resets assessment on the replacement (M37). The annual tax delta compounds and can erase a cap-rate gain.

suggestions.suggestion: Adopt six written decision triggers (extension rent/term floor; BOV floor; coverage floor; debt/deficit tripwire; insurance ceiling; sale-window deadline) and review quarterly.
suggestions.why: Near-tied strategies should be decided by observable triggers, not forecasts. Triggers convert waiting into a monitored option instead of drift.

suggestions.suggestion: Commission a parcel hazard + condition package (FHSZ/fault/flood, PCA, ALTA) before choosing hold duration.
suggestions.why: Tail risks are parcel-specific (B04); regional statistics (M39-M41) cannot price this box. Buyers will discount unknown hazard.
suggestions.risk_if_skipped: Unpriced black-swan exposure concentrated in a single asset.

suggestions.suggestion: Keep all private figures offline permanently; publish only normalized (per-$100k-NOI) results.
suggestions.why: Privacy is the top priority in the brief. Normalized analysis preserves decision value with zero disclosure of rent, basis, or identity.
suggestions.risk_if_skipped: Irreversible disclosure via git history / Pages.
